gloss: to put on sale, to launch

definitions.gloss: to put on sale, to start selling
definitions.explanation: To begin selling a product, especially at a special price or for a limited time.
To actively promote someone or something to gain recognition or popularity.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}を{来月|らいげつ}{売|う}り{出|だ}す{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to launch the new product next month.

examples.japanese: セールで{半額|はんがく}で{売|う}り{出|だ}している。
examples.english: They're selling it at half price during the sale.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{若手俳優|わかてはいゆう}として{売|う}り{出|だ}し{中|ちゅう}だ。
examples.english: He's being promoted as an up-and-coming young actor.
examples.notes: Uses 売り出し中 (in the process of being promoted)

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}から{冬物|ふゆもの}を{売|う}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Starting today, we're putting winter items on sale.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{毎年|まいとし}{夏|なつ}に{大|おお}きな{売|う}り{出|だ}しをする。
examples.english: This store has a big sale every summer.
examples.notes: Uses noun form 売り出し

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいスマホが{来週|らいしゅう}{売|う}り{出|だ}されるらしい。
examples.english: Apparently, a new smartphone will be launched next week.

examples.japanese: あのアイドルは{最近|さいきん}{売|う}り{出|だ}し{中|ちゅう}で、テレビによく{出|で}ている。
examples.english: That idol is being promoted recently and appears on TV a lot.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}を{売|う}り{出|だ}すのが{上手|じょうず}な{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: She's someone who is good at promoting herself.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}はこの{若|わか}い{歌手|かしゅ}を{全国|ぜんこく}に{売|う}り{出|だ}そうとしている。
examples.english: The company is trying to promote this young singer nationwide.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{特産品|とくさんひん}を{全国|ぜんこく}に{売|う}り{出|だ}す{計画|けいかく}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Plans to market local specialty products nationwide are progressing.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Compound verb: {売|う}る + {出|だ}す. Pattern: Xを{売|う}り{出|だ}す (put X on sale / promote X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {売|う}り{出|だ}している = 'is selling' or 'is on sale.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{新商品|しんしょうひん}を{売|う}り{出|だ}す (launch a new product)
・{特価|とっか}で{売|う}り{出|だ}す (put on sale at a special price)
・{売|う}り{出|だ}し{中|ちゅう} (now on sale; being promoted)

RELATED: The noun form {売|う}り{出|だ}し refers to a sale event or the act of launching/promoting.
